request: Implement live Empirical work visibility inside Taskboard from Start work through agent progress and durable completion, with a runnable end-to-end demo and UI tests. Preserve existing tracker workflows and display stale/offline state honestly.
message: Repair the remaining F-8 acceptance finding: malformed or unsupported Empirical repository overview must display Invalid source rather than Unavailable; add focused coverage, rerun required verification, and obtain independent re-review.

reasons.implemented: implemented has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.verified: verified has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.integrated: integrated has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.delivered: delivered has not been proven by a durable receipt.
reasons.published: published has not been proven by a durable receipt.

sizeDecision.reason: Both criteria describe one independently shippable Taskboard capability: link each started native task to its exact Empirical checkout and continuously render truthful, host-scoped workflow state. Splitting the observation protocol from the UI would not independently deliver the requested start-to-completion experience.
